paite: Hoih loutak a thupukna bawlte leh dikloutak a gelh mite tung agik hi!
english: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees;

paite: Meithaite tan ding gallak a laksak a-omtheihna ding uleh, pa neiloute thil laksak bang a abawltheihna ding un, nei zouloute vaihawmna diktat tangsak lou ding leh ka mite lak a gentheite muh ding mawngmawng laksak tumte!
english: to deprive the needy from justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their spoil, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

paite: Huchi in gawtna ni ahong tun chiang leh gamlapi a kipan huihpi ahong tun chiang in, bang na hih ding ua oi? Panpihna ngen ding in kua kiang ah na taita ding ua? Na thupina uh koi ah na nuseta ding ua?
english: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

paite: Hentate lak ah akun ding ua, thahte lak ah apuk ding uh, hiaite lel atan uh ahita ding hi. Huchi ahih in leng ahehna adai tuan kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

paite: TOUPA'N "Kisa in, Assuria mi, ka hehna khetbuk, ka lungkimlouhna chiangkhun tawi!
heading: Pathian Vanzat Assuria Kumpipa
english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

paite: Gallak la ding leh thil laksak la ding leh kongzing buannawi bang a ngap ding in amah zaw Pathian zah lou nam dou ding in ka sawl ding a, ka hehna mite sual ding in thu ka pe ding hi,” achi hi.
english: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me will I give him a command to take the spoil and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

paite: Himahleh ama'n huchibang a tup ahi kei a, huchibang zaw alungsim in leng angaihtuah sam kei; nam tam petmah a tam hihsiat leh hihmanthat ahi, lungsim a aneih zawk.
english: However he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

paite: "Ka miliante tengteng kumpipa ahi vek kei ua hia?
english: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

paite: Kalno khua Karkhemish khua bang hita lou ahi maw? Hamath khua Arpad khua bang hita lou ahi maw? Samaria khua Damaskas khua bang hita lou ahi maw?
english: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

paite: Ka khut in milimte gam, Jerusalem khua leh Samaria khuate sang a milim bawltawm hoihzaw neite leng, azongkheta uhi.
english: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

paite: Samaria leh amilimte tung a ka hihtak bang in Jerusalem leh amilimte tung ah ka hih kei dia hia?"
english: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in hichi ahi ding a, "Toupa'n Zion tang leh Jerusalem khosung a anasep ding tengteng asep khit hun chiang in Assuria kumpipa lungsim ki-otsakna gah leh amit kisathei thupina ka gawt ding," achi hi.
english: Therefore it will happen that, when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his haughty looks.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka khut hatna in ka hihta hi, ka pilna toh in; ka kizen ngal a; chi chih gamgite lah ka suan a, avaihawmna uh lah ka sut a, laltutphah a tute mihangsan hih bang in ka kaikhia hi.
english: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding: and I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

paite: Ka khut in chi chih hauhsaknate lah vasabu bang in azongkhia a; mi'n vasa tui api loihsansa ala uh bang in leitung pumpi ka la khin vekta hi; khazap hiam, kam ka hiam ham himhim leng a-om kei uhi," achi vial ngal a.
english: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, have I gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

paite: Heipi in thil ehna ding a azangmi akisaktheihsan dia hia? Sing-atna in atmi anuaisiah dia hia? Khetbuk in adom mite alik zosop diam aw, chiangkhun in sing hilou alik zomah bang phet ahi.
english: Should an axe brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Ami thaute lak ah gawnna asawl ding a; athupina nuai ah meikuang lai lel bang in mei toh in a-om ding.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

paite: Huan Israelte vakna mei ahong hi ding a, amaute Mi Siangthou mah leng meikuang ahi ding; huai in ni khat thu in louling neite leh khaulingneite kangsak in ahihmangthang ding.
english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

paite: Agammang leh alei hoih mun thupina leng, kha leh sa nangawn in, ahihmang ding; huchi in chiamtehna tawi pen kia hun lai bang ahi ding.
english: He will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

paite: Agammang a sing om zek laite naupang gelh tham phet a tawm ahita ding," achi hi.
english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Israelte khosuaksunte leh Jakob inkuanpihte lak a khosuaksunte'n amaute thatpa ah akinga nawnta kei ding ua; TOUPA Israelte Mi Siangthou, chihtaktak in amuangzawta ding uhi.
heading: Mi Tawmchik Ahong Kik Ding Uh
english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

paite: Akhosuaksunte, Jakob khosuaksunte, Pathian hattak kiang ah akik nawn ding uh.
english: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

paite: Na mi Israelte tuipi piaunel zah himah le uh, akhosuaksunte kia akik nawn ding uhi; diktatna luanletna suksiatna tung ding avaihawm puk ahi.
english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

paite: Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA, tawpna, tawpna tung ngei ding a vaihawm puk, gam tengteng laizang ah abawl ding hi.
english: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, in the midst of all the earth.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Zion a om ka mite aw, Aigupta gam a ahih bang un khetbuk a nou hon vua in achiangkhun na tung uah lik mahleh, Assuria mi kihta kei un.
heading: Toupa'n Assuria Asawi Ding
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

paite: Sawt louchik nung in ka lungkimlouhna ahong bei dia, ka hehna leng amaute hihmanthatna ding in hei in a-omta ding hi.
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

paite: Oreb suangpi a Midiante athah lai bang un sepaihte' TOUPA'N amah sual ding in zepna apei ding a; achiang lah tuipi tunglam ah a-om ding a Aigupta gam a apei bang in apei ding hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, puakgik na liangzang a kipan lakmang in a-om ding a, ahakkol leng na ngawng a kipan lakmang in a-om lai ding hi; thaunilh ziak in hakkol hihsiat in a-omta ding,” chi in.
english: It will happen in that day, that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

paite: Rimmon a kipan Aiath khua atungta, Migron ah apaisuakta; Mikmash ah avan akoihta hi.
heading: Dou Mite Douna
english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

paite: Guam ah atumta uh; Geba ah agiakta uh; Ramah khuate alingling ua; Saul, Gibeah khote ataimangta uh.
english: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

paite: Gallim tanu aw! Na aw in ngaihtak in kikou in; Laish a khua aw! Ngaikhia in; Anathoth aw, hehpihhuai na lawmlawm chia!
english: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

paite: Madmenah khote taimang in a-omta uh; Gebim a omte taimang tum in akidelh ding uhi.
english: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

paite: Tuni mah in Nob ah ataam dia; Zion tanu tang, Jerusalem mual pawng akhut asinkhum hi.
english: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

paite: Ngai dih, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, thil mulkimhuaitak in ahiangte asatkhe ding a, sang pipite phuk in a-om ding a, adawktuamte leng gawiniam in a-om ding hi.
english: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

paite: Sik in gamnuai sing sahte aphuk ding a, Lebanon sidar singte mithupi puk in apuk zuazua ding uhi.
english: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
